units: Targ. I Kings VI, 25 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. מִשְׁחָא fem.).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 26:2">Targ. Ex. XXVI, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 74b:2">Sabb. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>אי קפיד אמ׳</he> if he is particular about a uniform length (of the chips).
B. Mets. 107ᵇ לא תזלזל במי׳ (or במִישְׁחָתָא, pl.) do not treat surveying lightly.—Pl. מִשְׁחָן, מִי׳.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 13:32">Targ. O. Num. XIII, 32</cite> <he>אינשן דמ׳</he> (h. text <he>אנשי מדות</he>).—<cite ref="M02860"><he>מִשְׁחָתָא</he></cite>.
Targ. Ez. XL, 28, sq.; a. e.—[משחתא balance, v. מְסָאתָא a. מִסְהֲתָא.]
